_about: Sir George Webbe Dasent's (1817-1896) English translations of the Norwegian folk tales collected by Peter Christen Asbjørnsen and Jørgen Moe: Popular Tales from the Norse (1859) and Tales from the Fjeld (1874). Dasent is the translator, recorded in each title. Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain.

dasent-popular-tales-from-the-norse: Popular Tales from the Norse, Asbjørnsen and Moe, tr. George Webbe Dasent (1859)
dasent-tales-from-the-fjeld: Tales from the Fjeld, Asbjørnsen, tr. George Webbe Dasent (1874)

_excluded.dasent-selection: A Selection from the Norse Tales for the Use of Children (PG 64189): a selection from Popular Tales from the Norse, a duplicate of its stories
_excluded.dasent-sagas: The Story of Burnt Njal (PG 597, 17919): a saga, not a folk tale; outside the relay's ask (it would belong on a sagas shelf)
